featured_reviews.review_text: Horrible horrible experience, the first day of makeup for haldi did go okay even though i had to give feedback to the hairstylist a 100 times, her way of doing the hairstyles are pretty outdated and will not suit younger women. Thank god for my bridesmaids interference we were able to manage. After discussing a ready time of 7:30 the artists are calling and harassing me in the middle of my wedding rituals at 5pm saying they are getting late and that they apparently are starving as lunch was not provided (which easily could have been reimbursed later i had no issues and providing lunch was never spoken we only had dinner arranged at the reception) right in the middle of my WEDDING. I reached dot at 7:30 to change into second look. Even after paying for the whole makeup look i decided not to redo my base as i was so frustrated with them. Did a quick touch up with eyes and lips. As i was rushing out for my second entry song they’re again asking me for their travel reimbursement??? They did the same when i was rushing out for my haldi event. Anshul needs to change this system of harassing brides and ruining their special days like this for travel reimbursements. It can be done later on the group. Honestly will never recommend Anshul Sarogi to anyone. Highly overpriced, highly unprofessional. There are much better options as i realised. Please do your research and read the reviews before booking artists this or anyone else. Dont have your special day ruined by people unable to do the jobs that we are paying them for!

featured_reviews.name: Khushboo Barot
featured_reviews.review_text:
A big thank you to the team for accommodating multiple trials for me and my sister. I truly appreciate the time and effort that went into it. However, the need for so many trials came from the fact that my first trial left me quite dissatisfied and unsure of the final outcome.

Secondly, I felt there was a lot of pressure to make advance payments and block dates quickly. For most people, booking a makeup artist for a big day is a very conscious and well-thought-out decision, and I believe the process should feel patient and supportive instead of rushed.

Coming to the engagement day, I had booked makeup for four siders. While the makeup done for two of them was absolutely amazing and they received several compliments, the makeup for the other two turned out quite disappointing. The foundation shade did not match their skin tone, and the overall finish looked cakey and extremely heavy. It also took away from the beauty of their outfits and the vibe they were going for.

All in all, they are very accommodating and sweet, but please make sure to take a trial so you’re fully satisfied with the output for your big day 🤗

featured_reviews.name: MONICA DASWANI
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing experience! Won’t recommend for the bride or even siders. Their team ruined the bride’s main Haldi event.They will charge you a bomb promising all the best make up brands, but not sure if they genuinely use it on the main day.
Sharing my personal experience, the make up was cakey and it started coming off before the Haldi function even began.Very frustrating and embarrassing for the bride to go through such a thing. I had to give her my own products later for the remaining functions which lasted longer. Only the main wedding look fortunately turned out to be nice, that too had to give multiple instructions for the ideal look.
During the trial, they follow an impressive process which assures a great make up, but miss out on the steps during the actual day. The make up started melting terribly, infact the bride’s sister had to ask the artist to wipe it off completely in the middle of the event.
Even after sharing the references and outfits quite in advance, their team failed to give the look me and my family wanted. Lack of time management even after we gave clear instructions to ensure the family gets ready on time.
In the second event, the hairstylist messed up and the curls came off making the hair look just regular.
My sister faced the same, even the fake eye lashes came off. When we tried calling their studio to address the issue, nobody answered and looked into it. Ridiculous approach and gave us excuses why it went wrong, maybe focus on training the team better. Overall, it was average and It was a mistake going ahead with Anshul’s make up studio.

featured_reviews.name: Rhea G
featured_reviews.review_text: Editing the review after my wedding. Had the worst experience ever! The make up team reached late at the venue. My sangeet make up look was so tacky and badly done that people came up to me saying that my makeup was melting, that too in a winter wedding. We had a provided a room for the mua team which was on the same floor of the venue where I stayed. They still came late before my varmala. I had to literally call them and wake them up. My sister had a severe allergic reaction with the contact lens that they put that it cost her visits to the eye doctor and 4 months later too her issue hasn't resolved. My reception look was done in a hurry as well. Sider's looks were so badly done that guests criticized on their faces. One of the artists from the team just sat and scrolled through instagram. The hair stylist was told in advance that a sider wore a wig yet she couldn't handle the wig. I paid this make up team even more than the photographers and it was all a waste. Terrible experience and also no sense of owning up to their mistake, even by Anshul herself. As a bride, I would never recommend anyone to book them. Charged me a bomb and only wanted the entire payment to be made ASAP. As soon as I made the payment, they didn't bother to do my sister and mom's make-up even decently. Worst experience ever!

featured_reviews.name: Shivanii
featured_reviews.review_text:
I went to Anshul Saraogi for a makeup trial, but the experience was so stressful that I didn’t even go ahead with the trial and walked out of the studio.
From the beginning, the communication itself was a major problem. Aneri from the staff kept calling me repeatedly, mainly to push for payment, and honestly every time I saw her call, it stressed me out. There was no sense of timing, no understanding, and no respect for personal boundaries. It felt less like a makeup studio and more like someone chasing targets.
By the time I reached the studio, I was already anxious and irritated, and instead of easing things, the pressure continued. That’s when I realised this was not a professional environment and decided to leave.
A makeup studio should make you feel calm and confident, especially during a trial. This place did the exact opposite. I wasted my time and energy and left feeling disappointed and frustrated.
I trusted the reviews before booking, but my experience was completely different.
Would not recommend this studio. Giving 1 star only because 0 is not an option.
